name: kavita
description: Self-hosted reading server for manga, comics, and ebooks

fields.name: KAVITA_PORT
fields.label: App Port
fields.help: Host port used to open Kavita in your browser.

fields.name: KAVITA_CONFIG_LOCATION
fields.label: Config Folder
fields.help: Stores Kavita configuration, database files, covers, and application state.

fields.name: KAVITA_DATA_MOUNT
fields.label: Library Data Mount
fields.help:
Optional library bind mount in the format /host/path:/data or /host/path:/data:ro.
Leave blank if you want to add libraries later from another mount.

fields.name: PUID
fields.label: PUID
fields.help: User ID used by the container for file permissions.

fields.name: PGID
fields.label: PGID
fields.help: Group ID used by the container for file permissions.

fields.name: TZ
fields.label: Timezone
fields.help:
Timezone used by Kavita logs and scheduled tasks.
Example: Etc/UTC.

fields.name: RESTART_POLICY
fields.label: Restart Policy
fields.help: Controls whether the container restarts automatically.

fields.name: KAVITA_NETWORK_MODE
fields.label: Network
fields.help: Choose the default bridge network, host networking, or an existing Docker network.

fields.name: KAVITA_IMAGE
fields.label: Image
fields.help:
Docker image used for Kavita.
Change this only if you want a different tag or image source.

fields.name: KAVITA_PORT_MAPPING
fields.label: Bridge Port Mapping
fields.help: Port mapping used when Kavita is not running in host mode.

fields.name: KAVITA_CONTAINER_NAME
fields.label: Container Name
fields.help: Recipe-managed container name from the source Compose example.

ui.overview: Kavita is a self-hosted reading server for manga, comics, and ebooks with a browser-based interface.
what_happens: A Kavita container will be created
The web interface will be published on the port you choose
Your config folder and library data folder will be mounted into the container
Bridge networking is used by default, with optional host or existing-network choices under Advanced
ui.data_location: Relative paths are stored inside this app's project folder under the mounted EasyDocker base config path.
